run_ocr_latex_cli: run the ocr_latex_cli to extract LaTeX equations from images using Surya predictors
create_foundation_predictor: create a FoundationPredictor instance as the base model for OCR tasks
create_recognition_predictor: create a RecognitionPredictor with a FoundationPredictor for LaTeX equation recognition
build_ocr_predictions: build LaTeX predictions from images using texify_predictor with bounding boxes and task names
save_ocr_results_json: save OCR LaTeX results as a JSON file with equation text and page numbers
